authority: User explicitly instructed on 2026-09-15 to continue the original quant PR1 implementation until the target is reached. Closed prior experiment ledgers remain closed; this is one new substantively different risk-lifecycle mechanism, not a reset or neighbor search.
parent_policy: Unchanged observed_admission_completion Owner and Config, measured as a fresh same-source control.
evidence: Source-bound pre-2026 control episodes from campaign_payoff source eddbc617787d85215124d974ea10ec8c4e89da68 show that portfolio/cross-section shock exits frequently terminate profitable campaigns. Across union/common-five/joint-leader-removal, shock-exited campaigns number 25/19/21 and their same-symbol close returns over the next 5 sessions average 5.59%/6.17%/3.54%, over 10 sessions 8.81%/10.68%/4.74%. These are retrospective price diagnostics, not executable counterfactual gains. The largest common-five 2025 winners were fully liquidated by CROSS_SECTION_SHOCK and the generic suspended-campaign reentry experiment later failed, so this experiment acts at the first de-risk decision rather than adding another entry/ranking/funding or delayed reentry filter.
hypothesis: A single-session broad/cross-sectional shock can be transient. Immediate zeroing of otherwise intact holdings may sacrifice trend ownership. Test a confirmation topology: the first such market shock cuts risk to the already-existing half-risk state; only a second consecutive market shock, or a market shock while already at half risk, forces zero. Account-drawdown shocks and all security-specific exits remain immediate.
control: Exact unchanged observed_admission_completion parent and its original RiskState.
treatment: Use the same CROSS_SECTION_SHOCK and ACCUMULATED_MARKET_SHOCK predicates and thresholds. When current cap is above 0.5 and no market-shock confirmation is pending, the first such shock sets desired cap to 0.5, never increases exposure, and marks confirmation pending. A consecutive market-shock close, or any market-shock close while cap is already 0.5 or below, sets desired cap to 0. A non-market-shock close clears the pending confirmation. PORTFOLIO_DRAWDOWN_SHOCK, BROAD_TREND_BREAKDOWN, PORTFOLIO_WARNING, security exits/stale quotes and all existing protective obligations are unchanged. Existing recovery=3 behavior governs any later cap increase. No buy is allowed on a cap-cut close and no expected sale proceeds are spent.
parameters: No new numerical threshold. 0.5 is the existing half-risk state; shock predicates, 0.18 drawdown trigger, volatility multipliers, recovery count, allocation, stops, eligibility, two-position capacity, fees, costs, delay, T+1, liquidity and materiality are unchanged.
screen: Fresh matched control/treatment accounts for union, common-five and joint optical-leader-removal through 2025-12-31. Treatment advances only if each scope wealth is no lower and MDD no higher than its exact control, with at least one strict improvement. Preserve fills/exposure and all raw accounts. Rejection stops this treatment: no 2026 replay, neighboring confirmation count or threshold search.
verification: first isolated market shock halves but never buys
account drawdown shock remains immediate zero
security exit and stale protection unchanged
limitations: All inspected history is retrospective. This changes a research risk-response topology, not an acceptance threshold. A paired screen pass would still require the same candidate to complete the original full validation before production promotion.
